payable.description: Resource associated with the payment (Boleto or Pix).

id.description: ID of the resource associated with the payment.

uid.description: UID of the resource associated with the payment.

type.description: Type of resource associated with the payment.

debtor.description: Information of the debtor (drawee) of the boleto.

is_payer.description: Indicates if the debtor is the one who made the payment. Automatically filled via bank query (D+2 business days after payment). Null when the query has not yet been made or the data is not available.

document_number.description: CPF or CNPJ of the debtor.

payer.description: Information of who actually made the payment (payer). Automatically filled via daily bank query, available D+2 business days after payment. Null when the query has not yet been made or the bank did not return the payer's data.

document_number.description: CPF or CNPJ of the payer.

duplicated.description: Present when the receipt is a duplicate. Contains the UID of the original receipt.

uid.description: UID of the Original Receipt. Null when the original is unknown.
